statements.t: The Company expects that actions taken in the third and fourth quarters of 2026 to align staffing with demand will result in annualized cost savings of approximately $80 million in salary- and benefits-related and real estate-related costs.

In connection with these actions, the Company expects to record a fourth quarter 2026 special charge of approximately $7 million, which includes approximately $2 million in salary- and benefits-related costs associated with targeted headcount reductions and approximately $5 million in real estate-related costs.
The Company is reaffirming its full year 2026 revenue guidance range of between $3.940 billion and $4.100 billion.

The variance between EPS and Adjusted EPS guidance for full year 2026 is related to the third and fourth quarter of 2026 special charges, which the Company estimates will be approximately $1.55, and an estimated $0.40 of Extraordinary Litigation-Related Expenses .
The call can be accessed live and will be available for replay over the internet for 90 days by logging onto the Company’s investor relations website.
